source.title: OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork
source.text: Customers say OpenAI's data agent in ChatGPT Work still isn't accurate enough. Under the codename "Athena," the company is building a semantic layer that gives agents standardized definitions for business metrics. The tool could also put OpenAI in direct competition with Snowflake and Databricks. The article OpenAI is building "Athena" data platform to cut down on AI agent guesswork appeared first on The Decoder .

OpenAI is building a data platform codenamed Athena to stop AI agents from guessing business metrics.

The system creates a semantic layer with standardized definitions for company data. OpenAI is building this because customers say current tools aren't accurate enough. This move could put the company in direct competition with data giants like Snowflake and Databricks.

Should OpenAI build its own data stack?
